description: The file defines an immutable implementation of a JSON object, including methods for creating, modifying, querying, and serializing JSON objects. It implements efficient caching and parsing strategies and supports nested structures.

classes.name: ImmutableJsonObject
classes.description: An immutable implementation of a JSON object that supports building, querying, updating (immutably), and serialization. Internally manages a cache for efficient operations and supports nested JSON structures through recursive parsing and handling.

classes.name: ImmutableJsonObject.SoftReferencedFieldMap
classes.description: A thread-unsafe cache and data structure holding the fields of an ImmutableJsonObject. Maintains string and CBOR representations, supports cache recovery, hash calculation, and size estimation.

classes.name: ImmutableJsonObject.FieldMapJsonHandler
classes.description: A JSON handler class for parsing JSON strings into a Map<String, JsonField>. Only used for parsing JSON object strings into the internal map; delegates other handling to default handlers. Supports nested object parsing via a stack.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of an empty immutable JSON object.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Constructs a new ImmutableJsonObject from a map of fields, optionally with precomputed string or CBOR representations.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Creates and returns a new JSON object with the specified key and value, supporting different primitive types and JsonValue.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a JsonField or a value associated with a field definition, returning a new JSON object.

methods.name: setAll
methods.description: Adds multiple fields at once, returning a new JSON object.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if the JSON object contains a key or path.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves an optional JsonValue for a given key or path.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a nested JSON object at a specific path.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a key or path, returning a new JSON object.

methods.name: getKeys
methods.description: Returns the list of keys at the top level.

methods.name: getField
methods.description: Returns the JsonField associated with a key or path.

methods.name: iterator
methods.description: Provides an iterator over the JSON fields.

methods.name: stream
methods.description: Provides a stream over the JSON fields.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the JSON object has no fields.
